desc: POV, Hamilton's eyes through the halo (continues from shot 25): Verstappen's car lifts off the kerb on the right and comes over, its floor and rear tyre filling the top of the frame.
Low, close on the cockpit: Hamilton's helmet under the halo, Verstappen's car lying right on top of him.
Monza: from the tifosi grandstand, the two cars side by side down the straight into the first chicane.
How it happened: Verstappen's right wheels hit the yellow sausage kerb, the car is launched, lands across Hamilton's, both slide into the gravel.
Close: the rear tyre resting on the halo's hoop, a hand's width above the helmet.
The car fades to grey and the halo glows, then the car is gone: just the halo, turning slowly. 'A curved bar called the halo.'
2018: tifosi on the grandstand steps boo and hold up red-X boards as a car with the new halo passes.
In a team garage: two drivers look the halo over - one shrugs, one shakes his head.
2018 car launch: Wolff on stage beside the new silver car, LED wall, photographers.
He crouches to lift a chainsaw out of its case, then holds it up at the halo with a grin; the photographers lean back.
The FIA load test: the press comes down on the halo; the readout climbs to 12 t.
In a hangar, a crane lowers a red double-decker bus onto the halo. It holds.
Bahrain 2020, lap 1 at night: the pack under the floodlights, Grosjean's white car among them.
Flat out, the white car veers right across the track - and hits the steel barrier.
From above: the car tears in two - the front half through the barrier, the back half spinning away and catching fire.
Close: the front half through the barrier; the top rail rides up over the halo instead of into the helmet.
He climbs out: hands over the top rail and a knee coming up, then astride the barrier, then down on the track side, a medic beside him, a marshal on the fire.
2018, in the garage: Grosjean sizes up the new halo, hand under his chin.
The halo on a plinth under a spotlight, shown like a trophy.
Back at Monza, from low beside the helmet, tilted: the rear tyre comes down onto the halo.
From above: the tyre on the hoop, then deflected off it onto the engine cover - away from his head.
Hamilton, helmet in hand, by the wreck in the gravel: hand to his neck.
The team garage on race day: Wolff on the radio, crew at the screens.
Back on the launch stage, front on: Wolff, chainsaw lowered, a grin.
POV again, Hamilton's eyes: braking for the chicane, Verstappen alongside on the right - his wheels hit the yellow kerb. Loops to shot 1.
